items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Jay McShann said to me.

ctx.x: Lot of times. Lot of times. You get that-
Yeah, somebody was saying, I think it was Jay McShann said to me. "The trouble is they get off the bus, eat a big dinner, have a full stomach, sluggish."
Yeah, lazy. Lazy. But you get off the bandstand tired, gee whiz, have a chance to grab a sandwich, you know, not a meal, get right on the bandstand.
